name: Fill from scan & local OCR
description: Extract text from scanned IDs, invoices, or payslips locally in your browser and map fields to W-9 or SA100 boxes with human confirmation.

seo.metaTitle: Fill from scan & local OCR — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Extract text from scanned IDs, invoices, or payslips locally in your browser and map fields to W-9 or SA100 boxes with human confirmation. Runs 100% locally in your browser via tesseract-ppocr-v6 with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Fill from scan & local OCR processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using tesseract-ppocr-v6 (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Fill from scan & local OCR upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Fill from scan & local OCR executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using tesseract-ppocr-v6. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Fill from scan & local OCR?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/ocr_scan.json or open /tools/ocr-scan?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
